reviews.text: We have just completed a 1-2-1 block session with Mark and couldn't recommend him enough! Throughout Mark has provided us with invaluable knowledge to support our 2 dachshunds who have varying needs one being reactivity! Mark understood both of our dogs behaviours and from his knowledge, guidance and support, we have made major progress over the past couple of months which we couldn't be more thankful for! I recommend My Kanine Services to everyone I know!

Honestly a life saver. We were having such a hard time with our working cocker puppy when we started the classes with Mark and the difference was amazing. The pup is now 2 years old and we still use something from the classes multiple times a day. We did the 1:1 puppy classes then the group puppy classes. Communication was alway amazing and the sessions were so much fun with plenty of support and education by Mark. Highly Highly recommend, I mention Mark to everyone I meet with a puppy 😅

Was looking for 1:1 puppy classes and a friend recommended Mark to me.
Now I’d recommend to you!
Each class was targeted at specific behaviours or goals. Mark was available in between classes for questions or advice
It was enjoyable for both me and the pup.

My dog was suffering from extremely bad car anxiety for the past couple of months to the point we were unable to take her more than a 5 minute journey. Got in touch with Mark to see if he could help make her more relaxed in the car. Mark came out to the house and gave us really helpful tips and advice on how to desensitise her to the car and begin to change her mindset to be more positive around the car.

The difference in her in only a couple of weeks is amazing. Now totally relaxed in the car, ready for her next adventure.

Can’t recommend Mark enough!

We just completed the 1-2-1 puppy block with Mark and I can’t recommend him enough. Each session was tailored to my puppy Frank. Mark was so insightful into tips with your puppy and the training we completed has really helped shape Frank. Thanks again to Mark for all the help!

I highly recommend Mark My Kanine Services. I worked with him consistently for 15 months with my two male yorkshire terriers, one with really reactive behaviours and the advice and training Mark gave us was invaluable. Mark not only helped, he listened and supported from a non judgemental view point. We worked in all different settings. My two dogs are now doing great with other dogs, people, environments and with each other. If you commit to the training, take the advice and action it you will get the rewards. Thank you Mark and to Shona who I also crossed paths with through training.  Will absolutely return for pack walks.
Highly recommend! Mark has totally transformed what was once a very people/dog reactive German shepherd, can't thank him enough for helping us become better dog owners for our boy

I have tried several dog trainers before to help with my dogs anxiety and being reactive on walks with nothing helping him.
Mark has been amazing, he knew exactly what training Chester needed (and myself) to make walks and being around other dogs more relaxed for both of us.
Cannot recommend Mark enough!
Thank you so much for everything

Cannot recommend Mark enough - friendly and so knowledgeable! the transformation in my lab since starting with my K9 services is unbelievable, from not going out on walks 4 months ago to now getting excited to go for walks, walking great on lead and interacting with other dogs and harper loves going to her training sessions! harper has came on leaps and bounds since starting 🤩
My Kanine Services have been fantastic with our puppy. The sessions are uniquely tailored to the dog and owners meaning we get the maximum out of our time. Highly recommend
Excellent service from My Kanine Services. Our dog is always well looked after and comes home happy and content. Professional, reliable and clearly passionate about animal care. Highly recommended.

I have just completed a block of 1-2-1 sessions with mark and he has given me invaluable insight throughout. From the very beginning, Mark took the time to understand both me and Skye and tailored our sessions to us. I have learned so much about Skye. Mark has helped me understand what motivates her and taught me to use play to build her confidence in a way that’s fun and rewarding for us both.

Skye absolutely loves mark and is always excited to see him at training. The centre itself is great, with a private large room and good spaces around the centre to put learnings into practise around real life distractions.

Mark is very knowledgeable, supportive and passionate to help dogs and owners and I can’t thank him enough for all the guidance. I will be recommending My Kanine Services to anyone who will listen!

I brought my 5 month old rescue puppy to MyK9Services at a time of desperation, really struggling with behaviours such as biting and resource guarding. I had done lots of online research and everything I tried just didn’t seem to work. Mark showed me how to tackle these issues with very a structured training technique that I hadn’t found through any of my own research and it changed my life. He has helped me build a solid communication system with my dog on how to set boundaries. We have had a few 1-2-1 sessions now, and my puppy is 8 months old- the difference is noticeable and these behaviours are easing up significantly. He also offers pack walks which are great opportunities to teach dogs how to walk around other dogs and be neutral. It’s also a great way to meet other people in the community who are in the same boat as you. I really struggled on my first pack walk as my dog was highly excitable, but Shona was so kind and helpful with me, making sure I was supported and comfortable whilst offering invaluable advice. They are a great team and have really helped me strengthen the bond I have with my dog. I would say even if you are someone who is comfortable training your dog at home like me, you still can’t beat proper help from the professionals as they can offer insight you might not have considered, and are there to ensure you’re doing things correctly. Yes, professional dog training can sometimes be costly, but having a well behaved dog is priceless- and to be honest for the service they offer I think it is extremely well priced, especially when compared to others in the same industry. One thing I really like is that these guys practice what they preach. You can follow them on social media and see them with their own dogs putting in the work they are recommending to us. You can see how much they love what they do, and how much they genuinely care. Training here feels like a judgement free zone- they just genuinely want to help and do right by the dogs. Cant say enough good things!

Excellent training experience. I learned so much over the course of the 5 one to one sessions. Having simple things to say and do consistently has made the world of difference to how we live, exercise and play with our lovely springer spaniel. Thank you so much.

I took Ava along to the puppy course at My Kanine services with Mark. I couldn't believe how much i learnt being a first time dog mum. Ava absolutely loved it and is now a better dog for it. Would highly recommend.

Highly recommend Mark! I recently completed several one-to-one sessions with my miniature poodle, and he was incredibly knowledgeable and supportive in guiding our training plan. He explained everything clearly and made it easy to follow, which made a huge difference. My dog absolutely loves him too! I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend his training services, and I’m looking forward to attending more sessions in the future. The location is great, and the training centre is always spotless and well-maintained. 🐾🐩

Booked a block of 5 sessions with Mark, omg! The difference in my year old pup is amazing!! He is very patient, (although I think I tested his limits at times) as its the pawrent being trained. He is so nice and explains every step and how that translates for the dog to understand. His unit is large, plenty of space to practice and no problem with car parking.
I honestly can't recommend Mark enough. I thought at one time I'd have to get rid of my pup because of aggressive behaviour but even visitors to my house can't believe how much calmer she is.
Seriously,, go to Mark, he is amazing!

We did a puppy block with Mark and Shona and it was brilliant!!
Mark is knowledgeable, passionate, and really took the time to understand both our puppy and us. Each session was well-structured but still flexible enough to address real-life situations.
We also worked with Shona who is patient, engaging and really loves what she does!

We saw a big improvement in our puppy’s development and learning, and, just as importantly, gained confidence as owners, feeling equipped with the knowledge needed.
The advice was practical, easy to follow, and clearly explained. We’d highly recommend them to anyone starting out with a new puppy.

Would highly recommend Mark for anyone looking for a compassionate, understanding and experienced dog trainer. He is very knowledge and also explains things in the simplest terms so you fully understand how and why he is doing something. Both my boys have attended sessions with Mark over the last year and wow, what a difference! My Rottweiler has some dog reactivity and with Mark’s guidance we are making huge progress with his all round behaviour and managing his triggers. My Malinois has been having sessions since 14 weeks old, not only has Mark helped me with his obedience from the get go, but he has also helped me create my perfect family pet and given me the information and help I needed for him to be exceptional in all situations he’s ever been in. 10/10 would not hesitate to recommend to everyone I know!

We started with Mark when Willow was 12 weeks old. I was looking for someone with Malinois experience and he’s been brilliant, super knowledgeable and Willow absolutely loves him. She’s grown into a really well-rounded family dog. I’d always recommend.

Been taking both my dogs to mark for a few months now and both dogs absolutely love it. One dog has reactivity issues particularly at home and implementing the training mark has taught us has made for a much happier household. Sushi absolutely loves her sessions with mark and we always get the most out of them taking away tips and tricks we can use in the show ring, at home and day to day life making for happier dogs and a much more confident owner too

I’ve been going to Mark every few months for a couple of years now with my rescue dog Zeeko.

I started because Zeeko had some reactivity to certain breeds, men and cats. Mark was really understanding and made my man-hating dog fall in love with him (and helped with the reactivity). I go back anytime I have a bad encounter that sets Zeeko back a bit, but Mark is always encouraging and knows exactly what to do and say to set me at ease with our setbacks.

Now I have a dog who walks well to heel, can pass dogs without a look, and is generally a delight according to my dog sitters.

I can’t thank Mark enough! He’s empathetic, calm and doesn’t force loads of sessions on you if your dog doesn’t need it.

We recently completed the 5-week puppy training course with Shona at My Kanine Services, and I honestly can’t recommend her highly enough.

From the very first session, Shona was incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely passionate about what she does. She created such a welcoming and supportive environment, not just for the puppies but for us as owners too. No question ever felt silly, and she always took the time to explain the “why” behind the training, which made a huge difference.

Willow absolutely loved every session and has come on leaps and bounds in such a short space of time. Her focus, confidence, and basic obedience have improved massively, and we now feel much more equipped as owners to continue her training at home.

What really stood out was Shona’s approach — everything was positive, reward-based, and tailored to each puppy’s individual needs. You can tell she genuinely cares about the dogs and their development, not just ticking boxes.

If you’re looking for puppy training that actually works and leaves you feeling confident, this is 100% the place to go. We’re so grateful to Shona and will definitely be back for future training!

We had a fantastic experience working with Shona and couldn’t recommend her highly enough. She worked with our puppy, Willow, over the course of five weeks, and the progress has been incredible.

From the very beginning, Shona created a calm, positive, and supportive environment that Willow absolutely loved. Each session was engaging and well-structured, and it was clear how much care, passion, and expertise Shona brings to her work.

Over the five weeks, Willow learned essential skills such as sit, stay, lead training, and general obedience. The improvement in her behaviour and confidence has been amazing to see, and we feel much more confident as owners too.

Thank you, Shona, for giving Willow such a great foundation—we’re so grateful for everything you’ve taught her! Will definitely be back for some group training and pack walks ☺️

I booked our 5 month old rottweiler puppy in for a one to one, 5 session block. We did not know what to expect, being first time dog owners. We had some some training of our own and felt that we needed the experience and expertise of someone who would be able to give us the tools and knowledge to make sure we get a well balanced, well mannered dog. What can I say, Mark and his team are absolutely amazing. We were shown things in practical and verbal ways that made so much sense and gave an insight into how our puppy thinks and what makes for effective and long lasting training. We were able to really hone in on some of the little problem areas we were noticing and Mark made sure that we understood going forward for our 'homework' what we needed to follow through with. Our puppy is now 7 months and is absolutely thriving. We notice her cues more and when to make appropriate and meaningful corrections. Her behaviour,  even though we are strong into adolescent phase now, has improved so much and she really looks forward to her walks, structured play and just all round fun, both inside and outside of the home. We are continuing all the good work shown and cannot wait to start up again at the end of April for some more, probably slightly more intensive, training to ensure our pup gets the best out of life!

We have took our crazy working cocker spaniel Otis to Mark since he was a puppy. He absolutely loves Mark and has came on so much with Marks techniques. Mark is really knowledgeable and is a great teacher. I always leave the sessions feeling positive and more confident. Mylo and Kai are great helpers. It’s great to put the training into practice in a controlled environment. Would highly recommend My Kanine services

Me and my sister had a great experience training our puppy, Rue with Mark the trainer. Mark is so friendly and very knowledgeable. He made the training easy to follow, and I’ve seen a big improvement in Rue’s behaviour and confidence. Me and my sister would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a great dog trainer.

Mark is absolutely amazing! Been taking my pup Roxy to him since we brought her home and we both love our training sessions. She goes nuts when she sees Mark and always has the best time. Marks always so open and easy to talk to as well no wuestion is out of bounds or too silly to ask. I honestly dont think Roxy would be as well trained as she is if it wasnt for his help and advice. Would definately recommend Mark to anyone for puppy to behavioural or just some help along the way. Also his own dogs are just just too beautiful can tell theyre well loved as well

Can't recommend Mark, My Kanine Services, highly enough. We had a very excitable puppy who was very pully on walks and now have a obedient and well behaved dog. Couldn't of done it without him. Betsy says thanks too 🐾🐾🐾 …

Cannot recommend highly enough! Me and my (highly) reactive dachshund did one to one sessions with Mark. The difference in Bobby between first and last session was night and day.  Mark is highly knowledgeable and completely down to earth and approachable. 5 stars are not enough, thanks so much for your help and for the difference you have made.

We did a puppy block with Mark and had such a great experience. From the very beginning he made everything so clear and easy to follow — we honestly wouldn’t have known where to start without him. His way of explaining things is brilliant and really helped us feel confident with our training. He’s super knowledgeable, professional, and really well organised, but also very friendly and approachable. Being able to text or call him for advice in between sessions has been such a huge help. Our Ziggy absolutely loved him, and we’ve already seen such a positive difference and signed up for a second block right away! We’d highly recommend Mark to anyone starting out with a puppy or looking for dog advice/training.
Thanks to Mark's professional and friendly approach both our Rocky and we graduated with honours :) . Honestly I would make it mandatory for new dog owners to attend a school like Marks

Where do I start!!!! We can’t thank Mark enough for the amazing impact he’s had on both of us, but especially Freddie.  We have learned so so much, probably just as much as Freddie and Mark has helped us every step of the way to make sure we understood what he was asking to get the most out of Freddie’s at home training as well, and reassured us or made us feel at ease when we felt overwhelmed too. We really have loved every minute of our sessions for the puppy development programme - we were so sad it was over but we’ve decided to keep coming back to keep learning - we truly believe Freddie wouldn’t have developed to be the amazing little puppy he is without Mark. Thank you so so much and we WILL be back!! I honestly could go on forever but you won’t need to consider going anywhere else because Mark truly has it all and helps you and his dogs who you can tell he also adores so much!!

We can’t thank Mark at My Kanine Services enough! We brought our cocker spaniel puppy Joey for his first lesson at around 12 weeks as part of the puppy developmental block and this was one of the best things we could have done for Joey’s growth, he wasn’t even toilet trained when we first went and with Mark’s guidance we had that fixed within a week. We covered lots of areas from crating/play and walking and also issues we had picked up along the way with biting/barking. Overall, we have went from owners who didn’t really have a clue to feeling confident and Joey has come on leaps and bounds as a result. Definitely recommend if you have recently bought a puppy.

Mark has honestly been a god send for us! We rescued Scouse back in January and was recommended Mark by a family member. Scouse is a Rottweiler and a breed that we haven’t had before, and given how powerful he is wanted to ensure we got in to training as soon as! After a few lessons we seen a big difference in Scouse and have worked on obedience to play to helping with frustrations around other dogs. He has came a long way and this is all down to Mark and his knowledge. He isn’t judgemental, clearly has a passion for dogs and helping owners. He has so many different ideas and suggestions for us to practice and use and doesn’t give up and looks for other alternatives to help us out,  and I’m so glad we use him to help with Scouse! Scouse also loves his lessons and Mark and honestly cannot recommend him enough 👏🏻 thanks for all your help Mark!

Where do I start!  Mark was recommended by my boss Melissa and boy was she spot on!  Mark is a genius, our very own Scottish dog whisperer!  Jess, my wee staffy was born 4th August 2024 and my first dog.  I was not prepared nor did I appreciate the commitment required to get the best version of your pup.  I joined Mark doing block 1-1 sessions and it was first class!  He trained me!  Who knew I talked too much to Jess!  Aka gibberish, and as soon as Mark pointed that out and I stopped talking, Jess paid attention!  He gave me clear commands to follow and I had a few weeks ‘homework’ to practice with Jess before the next session.  It was hard work, and repetitive to get both me and Jess in the zone but it worked and we couldn’t wait to show off at our next session before getting the next set of instructions to practice.  What’s next I asked after the block was finished….obviously Pack walks!  Jess has just been dressed so once she has recovered we will be booking in for that too!  Cannot recommend Mark highly enough.

Mark has been working with my dog over the past few months on his behaviour, lead walking and recall. We have noticed such a difference in Mikey since starting our training block and the information and techniques Mark has given us has been so useful! Cant thank you enough Mark!

Couldn’t recommend Mark enough! Have been taking our 6 month old Border Collie puppy from 14 weeks and it has been a game changer. We went for the Puppy Development Pack and it’s been great for Fig. What’s great about Mark is that he will listen and focus on what is important for you and what you would like out of the sessions. Sessions are spread out at recommended intervals which were super accurate. By the time your next one came round you had bits to work on and at no point felt forced into too regular sessions. We had never planned on taking our first dog to a trainer but it’s been the best decision we made. Also, Mark is genuinely one of the nicest guys which really helps to make sessions enjoyable for dog & owner.

Mark has been the best thing for our boy Frank. We've been going to him since Frank was 14 weeks old and hes now 9 months. Mark helped us with issues like resource guarding and pulling on the lead. He's taught us so much from basic commands to structured play and target work. I cant recommend Mark enough and neither can Frank! He's an amazing dog trainer and owner trainer!

Marks knowledge & expertise is second to none. We’ve throughly enjoyed working with him for the past few months. He genuinely wants you & your dog to succeed during each training session & sets you both up for success. Thanks for all your help & support, we’ll definitely be back in the future for some fine tuning/pack walks!

Can't recommend Mark enough! Me, my partner and our 11 month old lurcher Kodi, have been working with him since February. We were looking for some guidance with typical puppy behaviour and that's exactly what we got. Kodi absolutely loves his 1 to 1 sessions with Mark and with his help he's continuing to learn and improve.

We have been attending sessions with Mark for our rescue dog Romy. The sessions have been fantastic, Romy and I have really enjoyed learning together. Mark is so positive and has great energy, I have loved having his support he made a very stressful time much easier for me and my family. Romy is making good progress and I feel we would not be where we are without Marks help. I can’t recommend him enough, all his clients dogs love him which says a lot about the type of trainer he is. If you are looking for a Brillant trainer contact Mark 🐶
Amazing going too enjoy puppy training with mark

Just finished my first 5 week block with mark. Outstanding service and training every session. Mark was so keen to get the best out of Milo and ensured he tailored everything to suit his training needs. He was so patient starting every session ensuring nothing had changed in his routine and going over everything we’d previously learned to keep us up to date as well as learning new things. Our boy is already a completely different dog. We can’t wait for our next block. Highly recommended.

Working with Mark has been fantastic!
We were recommended Mark through a friend and honestly couldn’t be happier with the outcome. Mark had been fantastic with our Chow Chow, Chuck, who was stubborn and reactive. We have worked with him over the last 3 months and the transformation is amazing.
His patience, expertise and knowledge are second to none and he has not only trained Chuck but also trained us! We booked a block of 1:1 sessions and were able to work on things that were particular issues for us. Mark’s teaching style is superb and he makes sure his steps are clear and easy to follow. After each session we felt confident using what we had learned on our own.
We couldn’t be prouder of the changes in Chuck and we have Mark to thank for that! We will definitely be returning for pack walks and further sessions.

Marks support and expertise has been amazing from the get go!!

We came to Mark after trying several other training options in the hope of teaching our Cooper to be more settled in social environments.

Cooper has always been an anxious dog, which made busy and new environments a task for him to the point even taking him walks outside of our estate proved difficult.

Coopers traits of being anxious and timid one minute to suddenly being reactive made it difficult for us to train him, but Mark took the time to fully understand Coopers needs to decide the best training plan for him which has got us where we are today!

Cooper was once a dog that pounced at any passing cars and bikes whilst pulling continuously on the lead to the point it was unbearable, to a dog who now walks at our feet, enjoys his 6 mile walks in the countryside and spontaneous weekend adventures travelling around Scotland. He even enjoys people watching as much as me (win win) lol!

Me and Adam will be forever grateful for not only Marks help and advice but the level of care he gave Cooper which has guided us all to live a happier, more chilled life!

Mark was recommended to us after joining a dog group on Facebook. So glad he was. Our cockapoo Kylo adores Mark and can’t wait to get into training classes to see him. Though Mark takes no nonsense and waits until Kylo is calm. We’ve had two training blocks with Mark and the difference in Kylo is amazing. He has calmed down so much and listens to us now. The compliments we get from other dog owners saying how chilled he is. We can’t thank Mark enough . The one thing I didn’t want was my dog to be misbehaved and thanks to Mark he isn’t! Highly recommend, Rose, Alan & Kylo 🐾

Mark and My Kanine Services are fantastic!

Mark's expert advice and patience has been second-to-none. It's helped both myself and Rosie bond, interact, play and learn the most important aspects of being a dog parent and fulfilled dog. I was very keen to get the basic commands under my belt before moving forward with more experienced techniques - thankfully with Marks' patience, both myself and Rosie were able to engage in making all that happen. Working in group sessions was a real bonus for us both, as we were able to put that training into practice straight away. We're really pleased that we found My Kanine Services.

We went to Mark to find some alternative ways to train and work our working dog who has elbow dysplasia which limits what he can physically.

Mark has nothing but amazing giving us endless alternatives and walking us through each session and new activity. It’s been amazing and such a weight off our shoulders knowing that we can fulfil our pups needs even with his limitations.

If you need any sort of help with your training or just want to level up your dog training you have to hit up Mark!

Can’t recommend Mark enough! He has trained my xl bully since I got him as a pup and whenever I need help or advice he’s been there! If you need a dog trainer then look no further! Thanks Mark!! And Kai and Mylo 🐶🐶 …

Recently completed the puppy training block with Mark and his patience & attention to detail was clear from the very beginning. His passion for his craft made the experience flow smoothly throughout the 4 weeks and our dog Frankie always looked forward to his Thursday night sessions. Would highly recommend to those interested in the fundamentals of dog ownership.

Hands down the best dog trainer there is. Mark really listens to you as a dog owner and what you need. There is no judgment just the best help for you and your dog. Thank you for your patience and understanding. We wouldn’t go anywhere else.
Fantastic experience mark really takes his time to understand what you want to achieve he has a very understanding approach and takes into consideration that no dog is the same highly recommend

Our little dog Floyd needed some help with walking on the lead and being a bit more confident around other dogs, he's quite reactive & nervous at times, too. Mark was a massive help with Floyd and he's like a different dog now, he no longer pulls on the lead, he can walk past other dogs now without reacting & even his recall is alot better. The techniques Mark used are easy to follow & really effective and I'd definitely recommend Mark to anyone needing help and support. Mark also invited our cocker spaniel puppy along to the final class & did a bit of training with both dogs, too, which again was a massive help.

Mark was great, really knowledgeable and great with my two dogs. He helped with general puppy obedience and their confidence to be around other dogs which was a struggle before. Overall a great experience and would highly recommend his services.

We completed a puppy training block with Mark when our Labrador was 4 months.  We spread the 5 classes over a 12 week period to suit us and our pup.  She’s come on leaps and bounds with recall, obedience and lead walking amongst other things, and we feel so much more confident with her - which was important to us with our young family.  Thanks Mark!

I came to see Mark for help with Cody’s heel walking on the lead and anxiety when it comes to meeting new people. Mark was absolutely amazing from day 1 and I always left the training sessions feeling so proud of Cody and thankful for the training provided. Thank you Mark for supporting us both through this and we can’t wait to see you again!

Mark has been amazing with our GSDxhusky mix Loki. Loki is extremely nervous and doesn’t love being handled which in turn means he can act out, after our block of 1:1 training sessions Loki and myself have a much better relationship, walks are far less stressful and I feel more at ease with how to handle certain situations. Mark has been the key factor to that as he is extremely knowledgable and patient and tailored the training specifically to Lokis needs.

We are also going to be attending the group sessions and look forward to learning more😄

Mark is honestly amazing 👏!  He has helped me & my boy soo much. He helped me understand why Reo was acting the way he was and showed me how to correct this behaviour and allow him to buold confidence. Reo was on anxiety meds and was really reactive on leash. He was soo nervous of people noises and dogs. Now he's gained soo much confidence and enjoys learning! I can walk him without any fear or anxiety , and he is no longer medicated! I can't thank Mark enough & highly recommended him for any sort of training as he listens, explains and makes it soo easy to learn. X

Couldn't recommend mark enough! It's like having a different dog now he's so much calmer and so much more confident with the different training guidance mark was able to provide. Mark was amazing and was there every step and never gave too much to work on at once. Explained everything in perfect detail and was so helpful definitely would give him a message about any training needed.

Could not recommend Mark enough if you're looking for some help with your pup. We came with our Labrador feeling very lost, and bit by but he helped cover so much stuff to help with our journey. The one to one time was brilliant, took on board what we wanted to focus on, and went at our pace. Would highly recommend Mark to help if you are looking for it
I have trained with Mark since we got our puppy cockapoo! He has taught me so much and he has helped me set our dog up for success now and in the future

Cannot recommend Mark enough! We have trained with Mark as soon as we got our German Shepherd Lexi, we would not trust anyone else with her and have been training for almost 3 years! The support and kindness you receive from Mark is second to none and his knowledge is unbelievable. No question is a silly question. The tools from class and 1-1 training with Mark has allowed us to experience numerous overnights and pub nights with Lexi, giving her the best life possible

Although I don't have a dog, I have witnessed Mark train peoples dogs.  I can not recommend Mark highly enough.  He has so much passion and knowledge.  My advice would be get your lovely dogs to him as soon as you can.  It will change your life!!!

We cannot recommend Mark enough for helping with our 1 year old Ridgeback X Weimaraner. When we first started our 1-1 sessions we couldn’t walk Hunter without a Halti or get his attention when in the company of other dogs. Since our …

Mark is incredible at his job!

I can't thank Mark enough for his patience and expertise. …

I cannot thank Mark enough for all the support and guidance with my rescue dog, Gia. Gia had issues with lead reactivity but thanks to our 1-2-1 and groups classes, Gia made leaps and bounds. She is now a far more confident and calmer dog. Cannot recommend enough! Thanks Mark. 💯 …

We took our puppy Storm along to Mark for 1:1 sessions around the beginning of May to help us with the basics following on to the Step up class.  Honestly can’t recommend Mark enough, the difference in Storm from the May until now is …
Can’t recommend Mark enough. The effects of his training have been life changing. I used to dread walking my boys or taking them anywhere because they were hyper and untameable. …
Cannot recommend Mark enough. He is very knowledgeable and so welcoming, he also makes the training fun. Thank you for everything
